d51: Harry Kane’s breakthrough began with four loans: Leyton Orient, Millwall, Norwich City and Leicester City. In April 2014, he made his first Premier League start for Tottenham, and scored against Sunderland. Then came 2014–15. Thirty-one goals in all competitions. Twenty-one in the Premier League. The loan years were the route. That season was the breakthrough.
d52: Istanbul, 2005. Liverpool trail Milan three-nil at half-time. Then six minutes change everything. Fifty-four: Steven Gerrard heads in. Fifty-six: Vladimír Šmicer drives in the second. Sixty: Xabi Alonso converts the rebound, and it’s three-three. Extra time cannot separate them. Liverpool win the shoot-out three-two. The comeback kept the final alive. Penalties decided the trophy.
